description: This Java class 'EffectedResources' is an immutable wrapper that encapsulates sets of granted and revoked resources, used likely in a policy enforcement or resource management context within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: EffectedResources
classes.description: Immutable class holding two sets of resources: granted and revoked, providing static factory methods and accessors.

methods.name: EffectedResources.of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of EffectedResources with given granted and revoked resource sets.

methods.name: getGrantedResources
methods.description: Returns the set of granted resources.

methods.name: getRevokedResources
methods.description: Returns the set of revoked resources.
